scope: Only the three annotation-complete mined-development frames. No held image was scored in this diagnostic.
interpretation: Differences arise solely from reference labels and matching assignments. The checkpoint and every saved prediction are fixed. This is not model improvement, independent accuracy, or a generalization estimate.

contract.matching: Same-class confidence-descending greedy one-to-one; choose highest IoU remaining reference, stable index ties.
contract.predictions: Already confidence-filtered and postclip-filtered saved R41 outputs; no new inference or additional filtering.
contract.duplicates: Subset of unmatched predictions overlapping an already-matched same-class reference at IoU>=0.5; do not add them again to unmatched totals.
contract.point_metrics: Reference visibility2 only. Error measured only for matched boxes with finite in-image predicted point and confidence>=0.5; reference-visible points without such returns count missing, including points on unmatched boxes. Pooled quantiles are conditional on returned endpoints.
contract.unavailable_reference_corners: Reference visibility0 is unscorable for corner error. Predicted hidden corners are permitted and do not turn into missing/false reference truth. Prediction confidence never changes annotation visibility.
contract.selection_caveat: Mined disagreements and correlated pool images; not an independent test. Reference edits may change IoU assignment and the conditional error population.

reviewed_unmatched_triage.scope: Only the five reviewed unmatched reference rows in the three annotation-complete frames. No held-image or broad unmatched-prediction audit.
reviewed_unmatched_triage.endpoint_distances_are_diagnostic_only: These distances are for plausible unmatched prediction/reference pairs and are NOT included in the official matched-endpoint metrics. No reference visibility is inferred from predictions.

summary.common_pattern: These are thin topmost or isolated fronts. Plausible prediction boxes are about 1.8–2.1 times the reviewed frontal box height, often including rack/background or adjacent frontal bands. This is a diagnostic clue, not a reason to expand labels or lower the score threshold.

visual_assessment.official_score_effect: None. Row1 remains unmatched, and these candidate point distances remain outside the official point metrics.
visual_assessment.inference_limit: Physical correspondence is a visual diagnostic, not a claim about internal model recognition or independent accuracy. The reviewed reference is not modified to fit predictions.
